    blocks = []

    def dfs(u):
        nonlocal timer
        disc[u] = low[u] = timer
        timer += 1
        
        children = 0
        for v in adj[u]:
            if v == parent[u]:

                        comp_nodes.add(edge[1])

                    blocks.append(list(comp_nodes))
